Al Seckel.note: Attended Cornell 1976–78, left without a degree (Wikipedia).

Edward Jay Epstein.note: B.A. and M.A. in government from Cornell; Ph.D. from Harvard. No relation to Jeffrey Epstein.

Noam Chomsky.note: Degrees (B.A., M.A., Ph.D.) from Penn. At Harvard he was a Junior Fellow in the Society of Fellows (1951–55), not a degree student.

Kenneth Mapp.note: Harvard Kennedy School: executive programs and fellowships, not a degree program.

Bill Clinton.note: Alpha Phi Omega is a service fraternity (joined at Georgetown); Kappa Kappa Psi is an honorary band fraternity. Phi Beta Kappa (honor society) not counted.

Mark Zuckerberg.note: Member of Alpha Epsilon Pi at Harvard.

Ken Starr.note: Delta Phi Epsilon is a professional foreign-service fraternity, joined at George Washington University.

Bill Richardson.note: Member and president of Delta Tau Delta at Tufts.

Stacey Plaskett.note: Sorority. Initiated through the St. Croix Alumnae Chapter in 2019, not as a student.

Josh Harris (businessman).note: Wikipedia article text names Sigma Alpha Epsilon; Wikidata also lists Phi Delta Theta. Kappa Beta Phi is a Wall Street honor society, not counted.
